title: Oswald could not have fired all the shots that killed JFK

tellings.quote: I do know who did kill him Oswald could not have gotten off the number of shots

plain: Lee Harvey Oswald could not have fired all the shots that killed President Kennedy in Dallas in 1963. That is the claim of Dan Sheehan, a lawyer and longtime researcher of government secrets, who tells Michels he knows who did kill Kennedy and that Oswald "could not have gotten off the number of shots". If so, more than one shooter was involved.
